Name: Bitcoin
Creator: Satoshi Nakamoto
Description: Bitcoin is a decentralized digital currency and payment system that does not require a central bank or single administrator to function, as it operates through a peer-to-peer network of nodes that verify transactions using cryptography and record them in a public ledger called a blockchain. Consensus among nodes is achieved through a computationally intensive process based on the proof-of-work system known as “mining,” which ensures the security of the blockchain.
